title: Discount curve bootstrap repricing par within 1e-8
source:
import os
import pandas as pd
p = pd.read_csv("/input/environment/data/par_rates.csv").sort_values("tenor_years")
dfs, running = [], 0.0
for c in p["par_rate"].astype(float):
    df = (1.0 - c * running) / (1.0 + c)
    dfs.append(df)
    running += df
os.makedirs("/app/output", exist_ok=True)
pd.DataFrame({"tenor_years": p["tenor_years"].astype(int), "df": dfs}).to_csv(
    "/app/output/discount.csv", index=False, float_format="%.17g")
